capabilities: assign unique text and background colors to tags with a color picker
color all descendant tags using a parent/* wildcard rule
apply tag colors to Canvas cards and Kanban cards and lists
color folders based on tags in the folder note's properties
omit the # prefix from tags in the Kanban view
extras: README lists known issues: when an item has multiple colored tags, it is not always clear why CSS picks the given color; property-based coloring currently requires a manual detect button press or a page refresh.
problem: Obsidian renders all tags the same way, so users cannot visually distinguish tags by color in notes, properties, Canvas, or Kanban boards.

summary: Tag color plugin that assigns custom text and background colors to tags, with color inheritance for descendant tags and integrations with Kanban, Canvas, and Folder Notes.
